notes.title: Valerosa is Now Available os Steam!
notes.notes:
Today, we have fantastic news that we want to share with all of you: "Valerosa" is now on Steam!

This arrival marks a significant milestone in our journey. It will allow us to connect with an even wider audience and bring the "Valerosa" experience to players around the world.

The page is now live and ready to be discovered. Although we don't have a playable demo available yet, you'll find exciting details about the game, screenshots, and an overview of what we have in store for players.

👉🏻 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2560960]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2560960[/url]

We invite you to enter, add the game to your wishlist, and spread the word. It truly means a lot to us and we greatly appreciate it 🤗 If you're not yet familiar with "Valerosa", you'll find all the information on the Steam page.

Thank you for your ongoing support and enthusiasm. 

Stay valiant,

Team Ojeras 👀
